decisions.statement: The paths that move arrive as one map rather than one call for each file.
A call handing in no path is refused.
A path with no body is refused rather than moved.
A path a body already sits at is refused rather than written over.
A path landing where it already sits is refused.
A body that moved names its own imports by the paths its new folder reaches.
Every body importing a file that moved names the path that file landed at.
The importers are asked of the index once for the whole move.
A manifest naming a moved file as a way in states the path that file landed at.
No rung is reached for a file that moves.

definition: many files moved at once, with every body naming one of them repointed
